_comment: Per-target limits for x86_64-mini-pc (Beelink / MeLE / NUC class). Copied to /etc/deputyos/limits.json at bake time. Schema in deputyctl/src/limits.rs. See docs/14-limitations.md §'x86_64-mini-pc'.

limitations.reason: NVIDIA / AMD discrete-GPU tooling (CUDA, ROCm) not bundled; mini-PC SKUs don't ship with discrete GPUs
limitations.unblock: build a custom image with the discrete-GPU stack you need (docs/15-local-build.md)

limitations.reason: iGPU acceleration via Intel OpenVINO only — covers Beelink/MeLE/NUC silicon; AMD/NVIDIA NPUs not bundled
limitations.unblock: sideload the runtime for your accelerator (see docs/12-bundled-software.md §Acceleration)

limitations.reason: 3B local LLM runs at workable speed; 7B is feasible but we ship no quality SLA for it
limitations.unblock: use a cloud provider for 7B+ workloads, or accept best-effort
